name: The Second Rebellion
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
We're fighting a losing battle with Colonel Kurzen.  Not only is he a brilliant tactician, he outnumbers us at least 10 to 1!  To survive, we need to use his own, covert tactics against him.

Enter his camp to the east and kill his men.  Lots of them.  And get out before reinforcements can close on you.
narrative.objectives:
Kill 15 Kurzen Jungle Fighters.

Return to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Well done. The loss of those Jungle Fighters will relieve some of the pressure on our camp.

But now that you've had a taste of the forces we're up against, do you still want to throw your lot in with us??
narrative.requestItemsText: I hope you've been successful in your hunting, adventurer. We won't last long against him without your help.

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 33 to 46, 13,000 XP in all.

quests.name: The Second Rebellion
quests.objectiveText: Kill 15 Kurzen Jungle Fighters. Return to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.

quests.name: Special Forces
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Kurzen Commandoes and 6 Kurzen Headshrinkers. Report to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.

quests.name: Colonel Kurzen
quests.objectiveText: Kill 6 Kurzen Elite, 4 Kurzen Subchiefs, and bring Kurzen's Head to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.

quests.name: Mai'Zoth
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Mind's Eye to Brother Nimetz at the Rebel Camp.
